Naging mabigat ang daloy ng trapiko sa kahabaan ng Manila East Road sa Barangay Tagpos, Binangonan, Rizal bandang alas-6:30 ng umaga nitong Lunes, Disyembre 15, matapos sumalpok ang isang jeepney sa isang kasalubong na kotse.

Ayon kay YouScooper Eric Diaz, nakuhanan niya ng video ang insidente matapos niyang marinig ang sunod-sunod na malalakas na kalabog sa kalsada. Batay sa salaysay ng ilang pasahero, mabilis umano ang takbo ng jeep kaya ito bumulusok, bumangga sa kotse, at tuluyang tumaob sa gitna ng daan.

Dahil sa aksidente, nadamay ang iba pang mga motorista at lalo pang bumigat ang trapiko sa lugar. Makikita sa video na agad na lumabas ang ilang pasahero mula sa tumaob na jeep bago pa man dumating ang mga rumespondeng awtoridad, na ayon sa mga saksi ay dumating sa loob ng 10 minuto matapos ang aksidente.

Na-clear na rin ang kalsada at bumalik sa normal ang daloy ng trapiko matapos ang agarang pagresponde ng mga awtoridad. #YouScoop

Courtesy: YouScooper Eric Diaz

data.english_translation: The flow of traffic along the Manila East Road along Barangay Tagpos, Bungonan, Rizzal about six o’clock:30 this morning on Monday, December 15, after a jeepney hit a car on an oncoming car. According to YouScooper Eric Diaz, he got a video after he heard a series of strong curves in the streets. Based on the story of several passengers, the jeep moved quickly, crashed into the car, and turned on the road, and hit the next few more quickly after a few other accidents.

Information coming in that the father and son terrorists who opened fire at Bondi Beach had visited the Philippines just weeks before their attack in November, sparking concerns they were following the path of Islamic extremists.

Police are investigating Naveed and Sajid Akram’s links to Islamic State terror ideology after a flag was found in the car in Bondi following the shooting, along with improvised explosive devices.

The Islamic State East Asia (ISEA), also known as the Islamic State East Asia Province or ISIS-East Asia, operates primarily in the Philippines, particularly Mindanao, southern Philippines.
